criteria.text: Repository defaults and .env.example select z-ai/glm-5.2 for OPENROUTER_MODEL_MAIN and deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash for OPENROUTER_MODEL_FAST; core and helper routing tests prove those identities; V4 Flash requests reasoning disabled where supported without changing other providers; build_system_prompt always appends the immutable grounding contract after database prompt components; the capability registry preserves FAQ-backed showroom visits, conditional samples, tool-required stock/price/quote/order state, and manager-required exceptional commitments; missing evidence uses a safe unknown/unconfirmed tool-or-clarification-or-handoff fallback; focused tests, affected integration checks, full release gates, provider capability preflight, and bounded synthetic model smoke pass; production .env is backed up and exactly the two model variables are updated, the canonical deploy succeeds, release/model readback and app/worker/Redis/PostgreSQL/public health pass, and post-deploy synthetic FAQ/product/missing-stock/structured/fallback checks pass without customer data, Zoho mutation, quotation creation, or outbound Wazzup; prior release and model values are retained for rollback.
